acceptance: A loaded-but-truncated item prints as truncated, never as skipped (red first)
An unparsable item still prints as skipped
evolve inbox batches over the checked-in inbox prints no truncation warning
fix: Give LoadDir's warnings a kind (skipped: unreadable or unparsable; truncated: loaded with fields cut) and print each by its kind; shorten the 44 over-length items at a boundary so they render whole (evolve inbox add already refuses new ones).
summary: runInboxBatches (cmd_inbox.go:54) and inbox quarantine list (cmd_inbox_quarantine.go:42) prefix every loader warning with 'WARN skipped', but LoadFile's sanitization warning (item.go:237) is for an item that loaded and was truncated (title/files > 160 bytes, acceptance > 600), not skipped. On 2026-09-30, 44 of 241 items printed as skipped while all 241 were batched, so the operator reads a dropped queue. The truncation is silent in the prompt: those 44 lanes see titles and criteria cut mid-sentence (and mid-rune; see inboxbatch-utf8-and-resolution).
title: inbox batches prints 'WARN skipped' for items it loaded with truncated fields; 44 items reach lanes with cut titles or criteria
